correctness.rationale: For r C4 squares meeting only at a hub, directly derived local peripheral-sink enumerator T=3+10z+z² and hub-sink enumerator B=3+z from the 14 noncyclic square orientations. Blocks share no simple cycles, so gluing gives S_r=T^r+(z−1)B^r. For z≠−3 roots satisfy [T(z)/B(z)]^r=1−z. The rational R(z)=z+7−18/(z+3) has derivative 1+18/(z+3)²>1, and comparison with H_r(z)=(1−z)^{1/r} proves exactly two simple real roots when r odd and four when r even; r=1 gives S=2z(z+6), r=2 yields all four real, higher r have nonreal roots. Independent SymPy exact Sturm real-root counts r=1..10 and derivative at zero equal (3r+1)3^r corroborate, not prove, unrestricted classification.
